data.description:
## Context / Problem
Split out of bug adb6-4762-90f6-4e30 (peach-chemic-hairstreak) by operator ruling (2026-08-21): the fresh-shell fix pins bedrock_region_name = "us-east-1" in rebar.toml's [llm] table, but the verdict's provider provenance cannot yet truthfully record that the region came from repo config.

RCA finding (proven statically on the bug ticket, 2026-08-17): LLMConfig.from_env collapses CLI/env/config-file resolution of bedrock_region_name into ONE string via _llm_str (src/rebar/llm/config.py), discarding the value's origin. resolve_bedrock_region (src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py) then labels EVERY configured non-empty value as region_source=REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION — so a rebar.toml pin is mislabeled as the env var in provenance records (pinned today by tests/unit/test_verdict_provenance.py, which asserts region_source == "REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION" for a configured region).

## Approach
Add source metadata/plumbing so provenance records region_source truthfully (repo-config vs CLI vs REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION vs AWS_DEFAULT_REGION vs AWS_REGION), without changing which value wins. Operator caution (recorded on the bug ticket): provenance labeling may interact with config wiring and env-var handling — design to avoid regression there, and maintain portability across diverse environments (no CI-provider-specific trigger; see project.portability).

## File impact
- src/rebar/llm/config.py — carry the resolved region's origin (do not regress _llm_str precedence: CLI > env > file > default)
- src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py — resolve_bedrock_region labels the configured value by its true source
- tests/unit/test_verdict_provenance.py, tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py — update/extend the pins

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A region resolved from the config-file table is recorded in provider provenance as region_source=repo-config (not REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION).
- [ ] CLI- and env-sourced regions keep their existing truthful labels; resolution precedence (CLI > REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > config file; then AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION) is unchanged and covered by tests.
- [ ] No provider wiring/behavior change beyond the label: the resolved region value and every provider build path are byte-identical for identical inputs.
- [ ] Works with no CI provider present (pure in-process labeling; nothing CI-specific).
data.title: Label Bedrock region provenance (region_source) accurately when the region comes from repo config
